verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of any programmatic surface (API/SDK) at all — probes for llms.txt, docs-md, and OpenAPI all return 404s — so an agent cannot draft securities via any API. The platform's grant/vesting/board-approval workflows are UI-driven only, with no mention of agent or programmatic access. Missing for 10: any API/SDK documentation, evidence of programmatic grant creation, and confirmation that queued items can be created non-interactively for human approval.
